title: El Coqui
hook: 书里的小科基蛙想回到美丽的小岛，Dora 和 Boots 带他穿过回声灌木丛，再坐船过海。

cells.en: Dora shows Boots a picture in her book. “Luna Guitarra!”
cells.cn: Dora 给 Boots 看书里的一幅画：“月亮吉他！”

cells.en: “That coquí lives on a beautiful island,” Dora reads to Boots.
cells.cn: Dora 念给 Boots 听：“这只科基蛙住在一座美丽的小岛上。”

cells.en: “First we have to find the Echo Bush,” says Dora.
cells.cn: Dora 说：“我们先要找到回声灌木丛。”

cells.en: “Don't worry, Coquí, we're almost there,” says Boots.
cells.cn: Boots 说：“别担心，科基，我们快到了。”

cells.en: The Echo Bush says it back. “Yeah, who's talking?”
cells.cn: 回声灌木丛把话学回来：“对呀，是谁在说话？”

cells.en: They walk to the shore. “Now, where is the ocean?”
cells.cn: 他们走到岸边：“现在大海在哪儿呢？”

cells.en: On the little boat Dora says, “We're going to have you home soon, Coquí!”
cells.cn: 小船上，Dora 说：“我们很快就送你回家，科基！”

cells.en: “I know! We can jump like Coquí,” says Boots on the rocks.
cells.cn: Boots 站在礁石上说：“我知道了！我们可以像科基那样跳。”

cells.en: The coquí family sings in the tree. “Coquí! Qui! Qui!”
cells.cn: 科基蛙一家在树上唱歌：“科基！叽！叽！”

opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “El Coqui”.
ending: In the end, the little coquí sings with his family in the tree. My favorite part is ______.
